author: By Enjoyiana Nururdin
title: Owner of dog day care set for City Council after incumbent drops out
text: Ald. Dina Nina Martinez-Rutherford has suspended her campaign and endorsed Ryan Koglin, a small business owner, to represent District 15 in Madison.
